correctness.rationale: The source indexing is reconstructed exactly by taking m_k=n_k+1 as the least integer at least k^2/c with the parity of k. For h congruent to N mod 2 and b=(h+1)/sqrt(N) in a compact positive range, the local Stirling/Edgeworth expansion summed by the composite midpoint rule gives P(|S_N|<=h)=2Phi(b)-1+(b^3-b)phi(b)/(6N)+O(N^-2); the pointwise O(N^-5/2) remainder sums over O(sqrt N) lattice sites to O(N^-2). Substituting N_k=k^2/c+e_k and expanding at xi=sqrt(c) yields the submitted k^-2 expression. At c=5/4, the parity ceiling has the ten exact phases (0,1/5,4/5,9/5,6/5,1,6/5,9/5,4/5,1/5), giving leading increment coefficients (7/4,5/4,3/4,11/4,9/4,7/4,5/4,13/4,11/4,9/4). Their minimum 3/4 makes the increments eventually positive. Independent exact arithmetic reproduced all phases/coefficients and exact binomial monotonicity through k=80 as a finite stress test only.
risks: The proof establishes eventual monotonicity but no explicit least eventual index.
Uniform asymptotic control is used only in the bounded b regime generated by the submitted sequence.
